title: AI News Daily — August 22, 2026
summary: Nvidia struck another license-plus-hire deal that isn't an acquisition, paying Poolside $6 billion for its model-building software and hiring over 100 of its staff. Meanwhile, Broadcom is raising upward of $60 billion in debt to bankroll Anthropic's AI chips, without either company owning the hardware. And a new safety assessment found no frontier lab meets basic AI-control standards — Anthropic and OpenAI tied for the best grade, a C+.
